description: This PHP source file is part of the SuiteCRM project, specifically related to the Studio module's Tab Groups, providing functionalities for editing view tabs in the user interface. It involves rendering the UI for tab group configuration, managing language settings, and including helper classes for module tab structures.

classes.name: TabGroupHelper
classes.description: Helper class for managing tab group structures and available modules.

classes.name: GroupedTabStructure
classes.description: Class responsible for generating tab structure data for grouped module tabs.

methods.name: get_tab_structure
methods.description: Method to generate the tab structure for display, given module list and options.
